messages.content:
The platform team publishes its status updates as an Atom feed, and they gave us a
snapshot of it in feeds/status.atom. Please:

- teach feedsync to read Atom feeds: every <entry> should become a digest item like an
  RSS <item>, with its title, the href of its link, its id, and its updated date (or its
  published date when it has no updated date);
- add the status feed to feeds.json, named "Platform status", so that the digest
  includes the platform status updates;
- add a --since YYYY-MM-DD option to feedsync digest that leaves out items published
  before that day (and items without a date). A value that is not a real YYYY-MM-DD day
  should be an error with exit status 2.

RSS feeds and the rest of the digest should keep working as they do now.
